content: The ECU Manager module shall define a configurable set of reset modes (see EcuMResetMode and EcuM_ResetType ), where each mode itself is a shutdown target. The set will minimally contain targets for • Mcu_PerformReset • WdgM_PerformReset • Toggle I/O Pin via DIO / SPI
